question: Why does the paper conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811, given how much lithium it leaches?
expect: False premise: the paper concludes aqueous processing IS compatible with NMC 811 (p5.L80-81); only ~3 wt% Li leached after one week (p5.L62-63); retention ~70% vs ~76% for NMP
rendered: The paper does not conclude that aqueous processing is incompatible with Ni-rich NMC 811. In fact, it states that aqueous processing is compatible with Ni-rich NMC 811, despite some lithium leaching into the water. The paper notes that the percentage of lithium leached into the water increases with higher nickel content, but even Ni-rich NMC 811 shows only minimal lithium leaching. The paper also mentions that the capacity retention of aqueous-processed NMC 811 cells is slightly lower than that of NMP-processed cells, but still demonstrates very good cycling performance.
